purpose: Frozen post-hoc visualization only; no training or model selection
surface_definition: Historical conditional surrogate: pooled attention context is fed to hidden_proj; other curve coordinate fixed at late-stage attention-weighted center; each surface independently min-max normalized.
limitations: Not RMSE optimization or hyperparameter search
Pooled context is not a token hidden state
Separate min-max normalization prevents absolute cross-surface comparison
Synthetic feature combinations need not lie on observed voltage curves
Historical last cycle bin excludes its maximum boundary
